mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sa_quiz_question (quiz_id, topic, type, content, options_json, correct_answer_json, explanation, sort_order) VALUES (#{quizId}, #{topic}, #{type}, #{content}, #{optionsJson}, #{correctAnswerJson}, #{explanation}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT q.id, q.quiz_id, q.topic, q.type, q.content, q.options_json, q.correct_answer_json, q.explanation, q.sort_order, q.create_time FROM sa_quiz_question q INNER JOIN sa_quiz z ON z.id = q.quiz_id WHERE q.quiz_id = #{quizId} AND z.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY q.sort_order ASC, q.id ASC
